shall be

claims.claim: The bill sets no explicit remedies, penalties, or funding cutoffs for projects that appear on the list — the mechanism is disclosure only.
claims.sourceSpan: The Director shall submit to Congress and post on the website of the Office of Management and Budget an annual report containing the information submitted under paragraph (1) for the relevant year
claims.note: Verified by absence: the entire operative text (Sec. 2) creates only a reporting/disclosure duty; no penalty, remedy, or funding-cutoff provision appears anywhere in the source.

claims.sourceSpan:

on the website of the Office of Management and Budget an annual
report
claims.note: Inference: defense programs are covered projects (a)(4) and the single report is public (posted on the OMB website), so they share the list with civilian projects. Directly grounded.

claims.claim: The bill requires reporting on cost-overrun and schedule-slip projects but does not create any remedy, penalty, corrective action, or funding trigger tied to a project appearing on the list.
claims.sourceSpan: The Director shall submit to Congress and post on the website of the Office of Management and Budget an annual report containing the information submitted under paragraph (1) for the relevant year
claims.note: Verified by absence: no penalty/remedy/corrective/funding-trigger provision exists anywhere in Sec. 2.

claims.claim: The bill lists what OMB must publish but does not specify a data format, machine-readability requirement, or update cadence beyond "annual," leaving the utility of the disclosure to OMB discretion.
claims.sourceSpan:
post
on the website of the Office of Management and Budget an annual
report
claims.note: Verified by absence: source specifies 'annual' cadence but no data format or machine-readability requirement.
